meta.name: claude-mem-install
meta.description: Use this when setting up claude-mem on Cursor: local or remote worker, local host-login observer or remote cmem.ai inference.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在 Cursor 中完成本地或远程的记忆服务配置，让 AI 助手记住上下文。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在 Cursor 里编程，希望 AI 助手能跨会话记住内容。
copy.tagline_en: Set up a memory service for Cursor with local or remote options.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code in Cursor and want your AI assistant to remember context.

howto.what: 在 Cursor 上装好 claude-mem 后,Claude 通过 MCP 接入记忆:本地 worker 默认启动(hooks 随插件自带),由 claude-mem-local 对接;也可改用远程 worker 的 claude-mem-remote。观察者可选远程推理(cmem.ai)或本机登录。
howto.when: 当你要在 Cursor 上安装配置 claude-mem 时触发,流程里要选本地或远程 worker,以及观察者的推理方式等。

say.text: 把观察者改成 --provider host,走本机登录
say.note: 走回环代理,不占用 worker 端口

say.text: 配远程 worker,--server-url 指向我的服务器

howto.what_en: After installing claude-mem on Cursor, Claude uses MCP servers — claude-mem-local (default local worker) or claude-mem-remote (remote worker) — for memory. The observer can use remote inference (cmem.ai) or local host-login.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you set up claude-mem on Cursor, choosing between a local or remote worker and the observer's inference mode (remote cmem.ai or local host-login).

say_en.text: Install the local worker with npx claude-mem install --ide cursor
say_en.note: Starts local worker; hooks ship with the plugin

say_en.text: Switch the observer to --provider host for local host-login
say_en.note: Uses loopback shim, avoids worker port

say_en.text: Set up the remote worker with --server-url pointing to my host
